title: SEW Protocol Trace Fixture
description: Canonical format for SEW escrow action traces used by TraceEquivalenceTest and TraceRegressionTest to replay simulated sequences against live EVM contracts and verify projection equality at every step.

schema_version.description: Locked to '1'. Increment to '2' only when making a breaking change to this schema.

scenario_id.description: Snake-case identifier unique within the trace corpus. Used for test naming and regression lookup.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this trace exercises.

phase.description: Optional simulation phase label this trace was generated from (e.g. 'Z' for Phase Z legitimacy tests).

trace_score.description: Score computed by trace-score/score-result: attacker-profit + 10×invariant-violations + 5×liveness-failure. Higher = more adversarial.

categories.description: Classification tags used for selective persistence and regression filtering.

fee_bps.description: Protocol fee in basis points applied at escrow creation. Must match the EscrowVault constructor argument used in the test setUp.

step_count.description: Number of steps in the steps array. Must equal steps.length. Exists so Forge can pre-allocate the loop without parsing the full array.

steps.description: Ordered sequence of actions to replay. Replayed in array order; seq values must be monotonically increasing.

action.description: Contract action to invoke. Maps directly to EscrowVault public functions.

caller_role.description: Role of the msg.sender. Mapped to stable test addresses by _roleToAddress().

warp_to.description: Unix timestamp to warp block.timestamp to before executing this action. Must be >= previous step's warp_to. If equal to current block.timestamp, no warp occurs.

save_wf_as.description: Only valid on create_escrow steps. Registers the newly created workflow ID under this alias for use in subsequent wf_alias fields.

wf_alias.description: Workflow alias registered by a prior save_wf_as. Resolved to a concrete workflow ID before the action is dispatched.

expected.description: Simulation projection asserted against the live EVM state after this action. Omit on steps where no assertion is needed (e.g. intentionally rejected steps).

amount.description: Gross token amount in wei. Must be within ERC20Mock minted balance for the buyer role.

params_empty.description: Empty params object for actions that take no parameters (release, raise_dispute, etc.).

expected_projection.description: EVM state snapshot at this step. All numeric fields are token amounts in wei (uint256). Corresponds to diff.clj comparable-keys.

amount_after_fee.description: EscrowTransfer.amountAfterFee in wei. Unchanged after terminal transitions (struct is not cleared on release/refund).

total_held.description: EscrowVault.totalHeldInEscrowPerToken[token] in wei. Zero after any terminal transition.

total_fees.description: EscrowVault.totalFeesPerToken[token] in wei. Accumulates on create; never decremented in current protocol version.

pending_settlement_exists.description: EscrowVault.pendingSettlements[wfId].exists. True only between resolver-acts and execute_pending_settlement.

dispute_level.description: DefaultResolutionModule.getAppealDeadlineAndRound()[1] (currentRound). Zero for DefaultResolutionModule stub; non-zero only with DRM multi-round resolution.
